{{Top}}
The '''Blood Monarch''', also known as the '''Monarch of Thisspias'''<ref name="Pocket Guide">''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> was a single hereditary monarch, and the title of the leader of [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]]. Although the Blood Monarch was the world's ruler, it was the elected parliament that dealt with most planetary matters. The Blood Monarch traditionally lived in the [[Thisspias alcazar|alcazar]] of [[Ratamesh|Ramatesh]]. [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis's]] [[Oppo Rancisis's mother|mother]] had been a Blood Monarch of Thisspias. After her death, she was replaced with [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|Oppo's younger sister]]. However, this Monarch was assassinated in the alcazar. The crown would have gone to Oppo, but he chose to abdicate in favor of the following person in the succession, to continue his work as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Later on, Oppo decided that the Republic needed to ensure Thisspias' loyalty and even help for the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], so he challenged and defeated the Blood Monarch in personal combat.
